posts.t:
Capitals announce they've claimed Jack St. Ivany off waivers from the Jets. 

Picking up a right-handed D helps a little with Vincent Desharnais out 4-6 following appendectomy. 

Also, Rasmus Sandin -- a left-handed D, who played right side last season -- still out maybe a month or so more.

"We really get to see everyone's sides of themselves."

On the Capitals Halloween party, including how all the costumes came together, Cole Hutson facing Vincent Desharnais to finalize their idea, the Tuchs as Mr. and Mrs. Smith and bleached blonde hair:

thehockeynews.com/nhl/washingt...

threads.t: [Capitals PR] Washington Capitals defenseman Vincent Desharnais underwent a successful appendectomy surgery on Thursday and is expected to miss 4-6 weeks.
